verdict.rationale: Framer's Server API lets you "automate publishing," and external agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or Codex can read and write the CMS and project, with every change landing on a branch for review. That makes background automation possible, but only through your own external tooling and orchestration. Framer's native agents are conversational and prompt-driven, and nothing in the evidence shows built-in background, scheduled or triggered automations. missing for 10: native scheduled/triggered background automations, a first-party workflow/automation builder, documentation of unattended agent runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
